name: AI/BI: Marketing Campaign effectiveness
narrative:
You run growth for a brand advertising across TikTok, Instagram, Google Ads and Email in 20 markets. Late in 2025 revenue and conversions fall off a cliff — but spend never dropped, so return on ad spend craters and nobody can say why. On the dashboard the map lights up: Germany and France go red while everywhere else stays green.

Ask Genie and it names the culprit — a new localized TikTok creative launched Sept 1 in just those two markets, converting at ~0.35% versus ~3% for healthy ads. It quantifies the damage (~$62k wasted, ~$440k lost) and points to the one fix, no SQL needed.
